headline: Accenture and Google Cloud Launch Gemini Enterprise Business Group with 1,000 On-Site Engineers
whatHappened: Accenture and Google Cloud launched the Accenture Gemini Enterprise Business Group on September 8, 2026 — a global group designed to help enterprise clients scale outcomes on Google Cloud's agentic AI platform, with plans to establish a 1,000-person forward-deployed engineer workforce.
clientTalkingPoint: The models are increasingly abundant and interchangeable — the scarcity is in people who can install them inside your organisation. That's why platform companies are now paying a consultancy to train its own staff on their software, rather than the other way around. When your client asks which AI platform to bet on, the more important question is: do they have access to implementation talent, not just the technology?

headline: PwC's 2026 AI Jobs Barometer Reveals a Two-Track Labour Market — and Human Skills Are Winning
whatHappened: PwC's 2026 Global AI Jobs Barometer, analysing more than one billion job ads across six continents, found that AI is driving a "two-track" global labour market — where "professionalised" roles emphasising human judgement are growing faster than "democratised" roles where AI simplifies the work itself.
clientTalkingPoint: Professionalised roles are seeing twice the growth in available jobs and 42% faster salary growth than democratised ones. When advising clients on workforce strategy, the frame has shifted: the goal isn't to protect headcount from AI — it's to deliberately design which roles get professionalised and which get democratised, before the market does it for them.

headline: Deloitte Data Shows Only 12% of Organisations Have Redesigned Work Around AI at Scale
whatHappened: Nearly half of respondents (48%) say their organisation has introduced AI without redesigning the workflows or roles it sits within, while only 12% report redesign at scale with a new operating model behind it.
clientTalkingPoint: The gap between AI deployment and AI transformation is real, and it's wider than most leaders assume — in most organisations, the technology is moving faster than the operating model, the governance, and the measurement system around it. Use this data point to challenge clients who equate tool rollout with transformation — deployment without redesign is just expensive experimentation.
